name: badge
title: Badge
description: A small pill for a status, a count, a label or a tag. Renders a `<span>` by default, or whatever Base UI's `render` prop is given, so the same badge can be an anchor without losing its shape.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/badge

Installed to `components/ui/badge.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/badge';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/badge

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
